text: Chapter 12: The Weredragons' Vital Point@Weredragons' Vital Point
■Next Mission\nMove from Nebula Plain to\nStairway to Vital Point to start.
Find the way leading to the Weredragons' Vital Point that is\nfloating in the air!
You managed to enter the Weredragons' Vital Point thanks to\nPelulu and friends who held the monsters back. Hurry to the\ncocoon chamber where the royal dragon cocoon might be!
Filrocas, a Coenubia that is putting up a net to surround\nand confine the royal dragon cocoon suddenly appeared.\nGet rid of it with the help of Galaben the Imperial Dragon!
